description: Source code for the MatchCondition and matcher implementations in Kubernetes admission webhook plugin, including evaluation logic for CEL expressions and match result determination.

classes.name: MatchCondition
classes.description: Represents a CEL expression condition used in admission matching.

classes.name: matcher
classes.description: Implements the Matcher interface, evaluates CEL expressions to determine if a request matches.

methods.name: GetExpression
methods.description: Returns the CEL expression string from a MatchCondition.

methods.name: ReturnTypes
methods.description: Returns the expected return types for the CEL expression, typically boolean.

methods.name: NewMatcher
methods.description: Constructs a new matcher instance with specified filter, fail policy, and identifiers.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Evaluates the CEL expression against the provided admission attributes and context, returning whether it matches.
